title: Showing window previews should be delayed until the mouse cursor is still to prevent flashes
line: Moving the pointer over or across task manager window previews no longer makes the screen flash with window highlighting turned on.
explanation: With "Hide other windows when hovering over previews" on, every hover enter and leave on a tooltip preview called KWin's HighlightWindow at once. Crossing the tooltip on the way up, or the small gaps between previews, therefore faded all windows out and back in several times a second. The change (Christoph Wolk's plasma-desktop!2816, rebased onto master) starts and clears the highlight through a timer of half the tooltip delay, so a passing pointer changes nothing; once a highlight is showing, moving to another preview still switches immediately.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: delay starting and stopping window highlighting

Hovering previews started and stopped the highlight immediately, so the
screen flashed when the pointer crossed the tooltip or the gaps between
previews. Use a short timer so only a resting pointer changes the view.

BUG: 469983

media.caption: Master: sweeping across three previews and moving up across the tooltip; the screen fades to the desktop between every preview and on the way up
With the change: same moves; the highlight goes straight from one window to the next, and crossing the tooltip changes nothing
Master: a frame between two previews, the screen mid-flash to the desktop
With the change: the same moment, the hovered window stays shown
